# Filesystem test fixtures

`ntfs-clean.img.gz` is a gzip-compressed copy of `testdata/testfs1` from
[ntfs 0.4.0](https://github.com/ColinFinck/ntfs/tree/3110cafc0440a84f2593b5d3691e0b23b68ccb8f),
used under the accompanying MIT license. It is a synthetic filesystem image,
never mounted by the tests. Tests read it through an in-memory cursor.

`*-boot.img.gz` images contain only synthetic boot files generated by
`cargo run --locked --example generate_rawfs` using e2fsprogs, btrfs-progs, and xfsprogs.
The generator formats newly created regular files in a temporary directory;
it does not mount filesystems. Btrfs fixtures contain a default `@` subvolume
and exercise zlib, LZO, and Zstd compression. Tests decompress these images
into disposable files and pass them through the read-only partition interface.
Regeneration requires Linux and the named mkfs tools; running tests does not.
